name: Magical Scrutiny
body:
School divination; Level bard 3, inquisitor 3, paladin 3, sorcerer/wizard 3, witch 3

CASTING

Casting Time 1 standard action
Components V, S

EFFECT

Range close (25 ft. + 5 ft./2 levels)
Target one creature
Duration 1 day/level
Saving Throw none; Spell Resistance yes

DESCRIPTION

You designate a particular action when casting the spell. If the target of the spell performs the particular action during the spell’s duration, you are instantly alerted regardless of distance as long as the target is on the same plane. When alerted, you are not given the details of when, where, how or why, but you know that the action was performed by the target.
